# vendor/

Third-party code shipped with the viewer so that it does not load anything from a CDN.

| Path | Source | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three/build/three.module.js` | `three` on npm (`build/three.module.js`) | 0.170.0 | MIT (`three/LICENSE`) |
| `three/examples/jsm/controls/{MapControls,OrbitControls}.js` | `three` on npm (`examples/jsm`) | 0.170.0 | MIT |
| `three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js` | `three` on npm (`examples/jsm`) | 0.170.0 | MIT |

Files are unmodified copies from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/`.
To update, replace them from the same path of a newer release and re-test the viewer.
